sources.protocol: MonoGST+ reference call order: one Python Random stream per graph/g; for every group draw rounded N(f,(0.15f)^2) size clamped to [0.5f,1.5f], then sample that group uniformly without replacement
sources.adaptation: retain the supplied sampling rule; the five-level g grid was fixed on 2026-08-28 after the g=15 resource run, whose byte-identical queries are retained; generate every added cell without solver-based query filtering
sources.graph_identity_policy: reuse the exact graph.txt files frozen for P1; no graph conversion or resnapshotting
recorded_query_metadata: RNG stream seed and query ordinal
sources.rng_stream: Random seed string is {base_seed}:{graph-directory-name}:{g}; the stream continues through f values [200,400,800,1600,3200] and ten queries per f in that order
sources.design_revision: g=15 was generated and measured first; g={3,6,9,12} was added later with the same per-graph/g RNG protocol. Report every g separately as well as graph-level totals; do not describe the five-level grid as preregistered before the g=15 run.
